title: session.refresh raises ConnectionError when pushing local changes
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Lattice 3.1.0, Fedora 41 Workstation, server us-west-2.

STEPS:

Steps to reproduce:
* Start by pushing local changes.
* Generate load with the stress script and watch the connection gauge.
* Watch the log for the traceback below.

EXPECTED:

As on every earlier run, pushing local changes should just complete.

ACTUAL:

After a few hundred calls every connection fails until the app is restarted.
Under load the open-connection gauge climbs steadily and never comes back down.

FREQUENCY:

Reproduces roughly one run in three.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:46 in loop
lattice/sched/runner.py:134 in run_due
lattice/store/remote.py:80 in sync_all
lattice/auth/session.py:199 in refresh
ConnectionError: token endpoint unreachable (host=us-west-2)
